purpose: Acceptance cases for Opus to implement against the updated schema. These are not executable tests and are not replacement project measurements.

cases.setup: Use the documented physical anchors after applying the chosen coordinate convention once.
cases.expected: Storefront at the bottom of the reference plan; entry and stairs left; refraction room rear-right. Same physical locations in A01, E01, elevations and cameras; dimensions/area unchanged.
cases.note: Preserve an existing correction on a newer HEAD; no second reflection.

cases.setup: Model the room against the stepped rear envelope with identified outer/inner wall faces.
cases.expected: No spurious strip behind the west side; no extension into the rear-right recess. Explicit inner polygon and wall thickness/source. Previous2070/1820 values are reference hypotheses, not surveyed targets.
Containment fails for the entire footprint. Add separate inside/touching/crossing-boundary cases; do not test only the bounding box or object center.

cases.observed_baseline: 30 mm gap is silently treated as intentional by findings().
cases.expected: Do not label the gap approved/intentional. Report unresolved proximity/use when relevant. Explicit approved adjacency must have a different result; overlap must remain flagged.
Both functional relations are assessed regardless of1200mm generic cutoff. Include measured or explicit hypothetical chair/drawer envelopes; unresolved sizes produce NOT_VERIFIED, not PASS.
Missing warning only for missing door; collision only for intersecting door sweep. Door is an opening in both2D/3D and preserves documented right-side/inward topology.
Catalog dimensions do not certify placement. Derived gaps visibly retain unverified status. Verified future Z with a source is valid input; do not assert all Z remain null.

These values are labeled by geometry/definition. No scaling to45m2 and no equivalence of gross rectangular zone to7m2 net room. Update expected numbers only when actual geometry changes with documented source.
Floor mesh covers only the intended envelope minus staircase opening. No occupied footprint outside polygon. Reconcile ceiling heights/soffits and document visual assumptions.
Four explicitly configured elements with margins, interaxes and source/status; no silent resize to conceal invalid wall length. Elevation agrees with scene geometry.

Open cubbies, staggered shelves, continuous mirror slats, two drawer LED lines, chosen products and official logo match the applicable approved references. Do not derive fabrication dimensions from imagery.

Stable object IDs; electrical ownership/support/access fields known or pending; E05/E06 connection/access explained. Actual output manifest, readable CAD/PDF inspection and test commands/results recorded. Renderer light energy is not installation wattage.
